title: Money Exchange in Ho Chi Minh City: Choose by Area – AN Tours Vietnam (https://antoursvietnam.com/best-places-for-money-exchange-in-ho-chi-minh-city/)
body: Money Exchange in Ho Chi Minh City: Choose by Area – AN Tours Vietnam Home Blog List Money Exchange in Ho Chi Minh City: Choose by Area Money Exchange in Ho Chi Minh City: Choose by Area Updated and maintained by AN Tours Vietnam. Published 25 June 2023 · Content updated 6 October 2026. Exchange-rate timestamps are shown separately and do not indicate a new editorial review. Find central HCMC bank offices and bank-listed exchange agents, with practical checks for foreign notes, opening hours and airport arrivals. In central Ho Chi Minh City, choose an exchange stop around your actual location rather than travelling to a shop because it is called the “best” online. For the Ben Thanh and Bui Thi Xuan area, the bank offices below provide current, identifiable destinations. Around Dong Khoi and Nguyen Hue, Vietcombank also lists appointed hotel exchange agents. Compare the final cash quote, not an old rate in a review. Ben Thanh and Bui Thi Xuan: staffed bank offices Vietcombank’s Sai Gon branch is at 69 Bui Thi Xuan. Sacombank’s Ben Thanh transaction office is on Nguyen Thi Both are listed as banking offices, not merely cash machines: Vietcombank Sai Gon branch Address: Số 69 Bùi Thị Xuân, phường Bến Thành, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh Regular hours: Monday–Friday, 08:00–12:00 and 13:00–16:30; closed Saturday and Sunday. Directory contact: 028.38359323/ 028.38359262 Sacombank Ben Thanh office Address: 28-30-32 Nguyễn Thị Nghĩa, phường Bến Thành, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh Regular hours: Monday–Friday, 07:30–11:30 and 13:00–17:00. Bank service line: 1800 5858 88 Use the listed morning and afternoon sessions when planning your visit. An office’s existence does not mean it accepts every foreign currency, damaged note or amount without conditions. Tell the bank which currency and denominations you have and ask whether it can buy those notes for VND. Take your passport for identification and ask for the receipt and full calculation. “All currencies” and “unlimited cash” are not useful promises for a traveller. A bank can quote both cash and transfer rates while having different availability at different offices. If your currency is not commonly handled, confirmation before the journey matters more than the number of bank names in a list. Le Thanh Ton, Dong Khoi and Nguyen Hue Check the exact Vietcombank branch name carefully. The current directory lists its Le Thanh Ton transaction office at the Gemadept building, number 2 Le Thanh Ton—not the older 231 Le Thanh Ton address repeated in some guides. Vietcombank Le Thanh Ton office Address: Tầng trệt tòa nhà Gemadept – Số 2 Đường Lê Thánh Tôn, Phường Sài Gòn, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh Regular hours: Monday–Friday, 08:00–11:30 and 13:00–16:00; closed Saturday and Sunday. Directory contact: 028.38246466 For a hotel-based exchange enquiry along the central shopping streets, Vietcombank’s separate appointed-agent directory lists: Rex Hotel at 141 Nguyen Hue. Majestic Hotel at 1 Dong Khoi. Grand Hotel at 8 Dong Khoi. Continental Hotel at 132–134 Dong Khoi. These are bank-listed exchange-agent locations, not recommendations based on an assumed room standard. Ask the hotel about the exchange desk’s hours, currencies, identification and non-guest access. A hotel being open overnight does not establish a 24-hour exchange counter, and an appointed agency listing does not promise the highest rate. Arriving at Tan Son Nhat Vietnam’s official tourism payment guidance describes currency exchange and international-card ATMs at major international airports. After landing, follow the banking or exchange signs...

cite16†Return my order L74: ## Frequently Asked Questions
What is your return policy?
If you aren't completely happy with your purchase, we accept returns of merchandise in new condition within 45 days of purchase. Returns must be in new condition, in the state you received them. New Balance reserves the right to refuse worn or damaged merchandise. Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on non-returnable items. cite16†Learn more about returns. L79: 
When can I expect my order to ship?
All in-stock items ship within 2 business days. You will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking when your order ships. If your order is split into more than one shipment, you will receive separate emails for each shipment.
Carrier delivery times go into effect once your order has shipped.
You can track your order by cite17†logging into your account or by providing your order number, billing last name, and shipping zip code cite14†here .
When should I expect my order?
In-stock items ship within 2 business days. Carrier delivery times go into effect once your order has shipped. UPS does not deliver on weekends or holidays.
• Standard (UPS Ground) - 2-5 business days once shipped
• Expedited (UPS 2-Day Air) - 2 business days once shipped
• Rush (UPS 1-Day Air) - 1 business day once shipped
• USPS - 2-7 business days once shipped
You will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking when your order ships. For more information about shipping rates and details, cite18†click here .
How do I get a discount?
Sign up for our email list to get a discount on your next order and to be notified about new promotions throughout the year. For early access to promotions and to receive exclusive offers, cite19†create an account with us.
Additionally, we offer a special ongoing 15% off discount to the following groups:
• Teachers
• Hospital employees
• Medical employees
• Nurses
• First responders
• Military members
• Government employees
• Seniors 60+
﻿If you’re in one of these groups, simply verify your affiliation using ID.me to receive your unique promo code. cite20†Exclusions apply .
How should I clean my shoes?
Clean your running shoes and other athletic shoes with a mild, dye-free detergent (either for dishwashing or laundry) and a bristle brush (such as a toothbrush) following the steps below.
1. Test a small amount of the detergent on an unnoticeable part of your shoes to make sure it won’t stain them.
2. Use your bristle brush to scrub the shoes with the detergent.
3. Wipe shoes clean with a damp cloth.
4. Allow your shoes to air dry for 24 hours before wearing.
For shoes made of suede or leather, use a specialty leather or suede cleaner.
We do not suggest putting any of our shoes into the washing machine or dryer since many of our materials should not be fully submerged in water or exposed to heat.
Should I buy a running shoe, a walking shoe or a training shoe?
We design our running, walking and training shoes to support the unique demands of each activity. To help you stay comfortable and perform your best, we suggest choosing shoes designed for your specific sport or workout. This may mean you wear a running shoe while training for your 10K but switch to a training shoe for gym days.
Benefits of Running Shoes
• Generally have more cushioning in the heel at the point of impact, plus support technology specific to a running stride
• Made with more mesh to help keep feet cool during runs
Benefits of Walking Shoes
• Designed with the specific body mechanics and strike path of walking in mind
• Constructed to be more flexible through the ball of the foot to allow for a greater range of motion through the roll of the forefoot
• Have greater arch support to protect where the force is heaviest on the foot
Benefits of Training Shoes
• Provide additional support for both forward and lateral movements
• Designed for a variety of cross-training workouts, including HIIT, strength training, step aerobics, boot camps and short treadmill jogs
• While not intended for use in long races (i.e., half marathons and marathons), our training shoes can be used in shorter runs (i.e., mile races and treadmill warm-ups)
What payments do you accept?
We accept the following payment options: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, and Afterpay.
To save credit cards, debit cards, and gift cards for faster checkout, cite17†log in or cite19†create an account .
How do I become a member?
To become a member, create an account online by visiting our cite17†log in or create an account page and fill out the required information. cite21†Become a member for early access to promotions and to receive exclusive offers.
Creating an account and becoming a member lets you easily track orders, check out faster, hear about promotions and new releases first.
Can I buy something online and pick it up at my local New Balance store?
Yes, a selection of products that are for sale on newbalance.com are also available in a New Balance store near you. To see pickup options during checkout, choose “Pick up in store” and use your zip code to select your local store.
You can also set your store while shopping by using the store selector in the upper left hand corner or in the mobile menu.
